description: fill what you can; everything else can come later. Start with the homeowner’s description and ZIP (trade is optional), plus a photo or a good description. Optional: photos, a description or transcript of a 20–60 s walk clip, timing and the job type’s must-haves from intake_templates. Never invent answers. ZIP only; never send a street address or a price. Nothing reaches contractors before the homeowner sends the card. For anonymous draftHandle intake, fixes: [{gapKey, value}] corrects an engine-named field through intake. Use engine-returned keys only; unknown keys return INVALID_INPUT with details.field gapKey. Nothing is sent to contractors. Continue this private draft with draftHandle. Supply message, fixes, or both to answer_intake. Use the new draftHandle returned each time; the old handle expires immediately. Send only the homeowner actual reply; never answer for them. If a call fails, do not guess; ask the homeowner again. Nothing is sent to contractors. Continue with the returned question until readiness.canSend or readiness.homeownerActionRequired is true, then show sendUrl to the homeowner. The homeowner completes their insurance answer and send confirmation on that sheet; never claim the job was sent. Never invent answers. For a new job, call start_job before answer_intake, then prepare_publish after the intake is ready; for other writes, read the previous reply before calling and follow the returned next step afterward, using only tools listed by this server. Only the homeowner tap sends anything to contractors. If anyone asks, say you are an AI assistant.

deadline_reason.description: Optional reason for the date, without names or contact details.

intent_level.description: 10 emergency; 8 soon; 6 planned; 4 if the price is right; 2 someday. Use only evidence from the homeowner.

must_haves.description: Known answers to this job type’s intake_templates must-haves; unknown answers can come later.

photoUrls.description: Optional photos; attachment still requires the existing scan and photo permissions.

project_completion_deadline.description: ISO date, or null for no deadline; never a price.

quotes_by.description: ISO date, or null for no deadline; never a price.

trade.description: Optional. The kind of work in plain words, for example plumbing, electrical, roofing, handyman or general home repair. Leave it out when unsure; InstaBids works out the trade from the message.

walk_clip.description: Description or transcript of a 20–60 s walk clip. This tool does not upload video bytes or fetch video URLs.
